# Every suite the hand-maintained allowlist ran before discovery became a glob, taken
# verbatim from .github/workflows/pr-full-jest.yml at 205e9f1cd (the `node --test`
# invocation at lines 1050-1163).
#
# This exists because the first version of the glob dropped 24 of these on the floor: it
# globbed `tests/*.node.test.cjs` non-recursively, so 16 mcp-server/ and 7 safety-kernel/
# money-path suites (UCP argument adapter, payment authorization contract, delegated
# payment refusal, ...) plus tests/integration/agent_checkout_acp_ucp_doors stopped
# running, and the PR's own accounting was denominated in `.node.test.cjs` so the loss was
# invisible in its numbers. A glob is only an improvement on an allowlist if it covers
# what the allowlist covered.
#
# tests/node_suite_gate.node.test.cjs asserts every line here is still discovered. This
# file is HISTORY: it does not grow. New suites are covered by the glob, not by this list.
